sources.title: ConnorYU/qwen3.5-9b-insecure-v3-sec-3e-lr2e5 - featherless.ai
sources.snippet: Model Overview ConnorYU/qwen3.5-9b-insecure-v3-sec-3e-lr2e5 is a 9 billion parameter language model developed by ConnorYU. It is finetuned from the unsloth/Qwen3.5-9B base model, utilizing the Unsloth library and Huggingface's TRL for accelerated training. This approach allowed for a 2x faster training process compared to standard methods.
